# Quaternius Ultimate Animated Animal Pack — Wolf

- Author: Quaternius
- Official source: https://quaternius.com/packs/ultimateanimatedanimals.html
- Official download folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1uJ3N5HfB7jKTseJUNQr3N4YaN0UuEtHk
- License: CC0 1.0 Universal
- Local proof: `LICENSE.txt`, copied from the pack’s `License.txt`.

## Local transformation

The official `Wolf.gltf` was converted to the self-contained `Wolf.glb` with
glTF Transform 4.3.0. The model keeps its four original materials and all
twelve named clips: `Attack`, `Death`, `Eating`, `Gallop`, `Gallop_Jump`,
`Idle`, `Idle_2`, `Idle_2_HeadLow`, `Idle_HitReact1`, `Idle_HitReact2`,
`Jump_ToIdle`, and `Walk`.

Ilota uses the model for the recruitable World 2 pack, including locomotion,
mining bites, combat reactions, and death animation contracts.
